newsitem.title: FRANCE: Scor sees 10 pct sales rise, dlr, stg help.
newsitem.headline: Scor sees 10 pct sales rise, dlr, stg help.

text.p: French reinsurer Scor expects sales to rise 10 percent this year, with a considerable part of this due to the rise in the dollar and sterling, Scor chairman Jacques Blondeau said in an interview to be published on Saturday.

"A rise in the region of 10 percent in sales can be expected for the financial year as a whole, helped by the dollar and sterling," he said, according to an advance copy of the interview in Le Journal des Finances, which was supplied to Reuters.
"If our sales rise 10 percent, half of it will be due to the changes in exchange rates," he was quoted as saying.
Blondeau also said he expected the technical result to improve in 1997 despite continual cutting in insurance tariffs for natural catastrophes, in transport and in big industrial risks.
